description: Election Commission - I. G. V. P. Weerasekara was elected as the member of the Kotikawatta Mulleriyawa Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Kotikawatta Mulleriyawa Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of a member, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of a new elected member for a specific ward, which falls under electoral processes and related administrative matters. This fits the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) for electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authority elections.
